descriptions.d26c_actor_ground_arrive_800d911c: Step through 0x800b0824. Return when the current frame is past the planned time, or equal unless the plan is -1. Otherwise set the message id and the time, post the 8-byte tick message, make sure the global table is ready (0x800bd920), copy and normalize the global direction, copy the global up vector, call virtual +48 with time plus +368, and copy the global stamp to +360 and +364.
